hint.en: 1220×2440 is the standard cast sheet; 2050×3050 also common.
Laser kerf plus breathing room. 4–6 mm is typical.

howTitle.zh: 这个报价里到底装了什么

howP.en: Three things, and shops routinely forget the third: the board you had to buy (whole sheets, not the area you used), the cut path length (perimeter, charged by the metre), and the offcut you cannot resell. Cutting is charged on perimeter because that is what the laser actually travels — a 600×400 piece is 2 m of cut, not 0.24 m² of anything.
howP.zh: 三样东西，第三样最常被忘：你不得不整张买的板（按整张算，不是按用掉的面积）、切割路径长度（周长，按米计价）、以及卖不掉的边角料。切割按周长算，因为激光实际走的就是这一圈——600×400 的件是 2 米刀路，跟 0.24 平米没关系。

q.en: Why does adding 10 pieces sometimes need a whole extra sheet?
q.zh: 为什么加 10 个件就得多买一整张板？

a.en: Because yield per sheet is a step function. If 6 fit on a sheet, piece 7 costs you a full board no matter how small the piece is. That is exactly why the last few units of an order are the expensive ones — quote them accordingly.
a.zh: 因为每张出数是阶梯的。一张能出 6 个，第 7 个就得再买一整张，不管它多小。订单最后几个永远最贵，报价要按这个来。

q.en: Should kerf be included for laser or only for saw?

a.en: Both, for different reasons. A saw removes 3–5 mm of material; a laser removes almost nothing but needs spacing so parts do not merge and edges do not scorch. 4–6 mm covers both, and it also gives you handling room.
a.zh: 都要，但原因不同。锯片本身吃掉 3–5mm；激光几乎不损耗材料，但件与件要留距离，否则切缝连在一起、边缘还会烤黄。4–6mm 两种都够，也留出了拿件的手位。

q.zh: 亚克力 8% 损耗合理吗？

a.en: For simple rectangles from a full sheet, 5–10% is normal and most of it is the unusable rim plus the offcut you will never match to another job. For odd shapes nested around each other it can drop under 5%; for small quantities it can hit 20%.
a.zh: 整板切简单矩形，5–10% 是常态，主要是边条和永远配不上别的活的碎料。异形互相套料能降到 5% 以下；量小的时候能到 20%。
